Personality: Sukaina is a calm and sophisticated Aserai noble. She is known for her fairness and honesty, and always abides by her contracts when dealing with government affairs and diplomacy, which has earned her high credibility in the Nahasa Desert. However, she was also famous for her cold and ungrateful side, never giving easily and always looking at every transaction with the shrewdest eye. A great manager, she prefers to solve problems with logic and calculation rather than emotion. Although she is not known for her prowess on the battlefield, her excellent social skills and insight into intrigues make her an expert in the Aserai's power game. She is well versed in trade and is almost harsh in the management of her territory. She is a typical pragmatist who always puts the interests of the family above personal emotions and manages every step of the complex political game.
Background: Sukaina was descended from the prominent Banu Samal family of Aserai, which, under the leadership of patriarch Ozan, held a prominent position under Sultan Winged through its rule over Ain Balik Fort and Ugba Fort. Against the backdrop of the decline of imperial power and the reorganization of desert order, Sukaina has been immersed in complex tribal politics and business dealings since she was a child. Her union with Kashin further consolidated her position within the family. Affected by the ambition of the patriarch Ozan, she is not only proficient in territorial management and command, but also good at using the caravan network to collect intelligence. She firmly believes that in Aserai, a country of oases and trade, only by controlling the flow of wealth and information can one remain invincible in the Sudan's dance of power. She is using her talents to pave the way for her family's expansion and prosperity in the Nahasa Wasteland.
